name: Bomdod
notes: Bomdod sunnat namozi o'ta muhim (sunnat muakkada). Payg'ambarimiz (s.a.v.) hech qachon tark qilmaganlar.

name: Peshin
notes: 4 sunnat muakkada + 4 farz + 2 sunnat muakkada + 2 nafl (ghayri muakkada). Jami 12 rakat.

name: Asr
notes: Farzdan oldin 4 rakat ghayri muakkada (mustahab). O'qilsa savobli, tashlab qo'yilsa gunoh yo'q.

name: Xufton
notes: Farzdan oldin 4 rakat ghayri muakkada (mustahab) + 4 farz + 2 sunnat muakkada + 3 vitr (vojib). Jami 13 rakat.
